column860: caption"":""Follow us on @followmetraveller to see more backstage photos and stories of our current trip to Cambodia and Myanmar. \ud83c\udf05  Here we are at the Beng Mealea temple. Being there you just can't believe that these structures are built by humans. They consist of a huge amount of perfect rectangle stones that are perfectly aligned against each other. Somewhere you wouldn't even be able to put a sheet of paper in the joint. There is no cement connecting those stones and they lay there for centuries. They say that elephants were used to lift and align them....and that it took 32-40 years to build it. Some structure in Europe that require far less amount of stones took 100-200 years to be built.\ud83c\udf05 \u041e\u043d\u0438 \u0433\u043e\u0432\u043e\u0440\u044f\u0442
